meaning: Each covered app has a checked Lean theorem or Quint invariant stating its catalogued first_formal_obligation. Not a refinement claim.

agent_core.note: Every launch ran an approved profile whose current manifest revision equals the run's pinned digest (Profiles.resolve/3 approval and digest checks).

agent_ops_store.note: Competing and stale lease holders launch the external effect at most once.

barter_core.note: Optimizer and brokerage previews leave ownership unchanged; an asset changes hands only through an admission its provider signed (the admission half is a host duty, not code in barter_core).

biz-kit.note: Every effect committed through Log.append/2 has a registered type, an authenticated signature, its owning type's admission check, and a unique event id.

biz_kit_cluster.note: Singleton :global conflict resolution leaves at most one running instance after a heal; no fencing token exists (finding).

biz_kit_composition.note: Composition.preview discards the reserved next state and returns unsigned candidates, so committed reservations, sales and handoffs never exceed admitted signed commands.

biz_kit_extension.note: Catalog build, activation planning and registry visibility never grant permissions, invoke an extension or write authoritative state.

biz_kit_identity.note: Sessions restore tickets: a SessionStore read pending across revoke_principal cannot re-insert the session, so a revoked principal never acts.

commerce_core.note: Tax.flat/allocate shares sum exactly to the half-up order total for every choice of the extra indices, and extra never exceeds the number of bases.

coop_substrate.note: Log append admits only signed, gate-authorized, non-replayed envelopes and assigns a derived stream and an unbroken sequence/hash chain.

dispatch.note: One-active-per-exclusive-driver (partial unique index one_active_per_operator) plus vehicle exclusivity; the vehicle half is the intended rule, not enforced in code.

dispatch_core.note: LastMile cancel_confirmed only before pickup; pickup and delivery refs are never fabricated or erased by cancellation.

eatsbot.note: Planned R5 cutover: no legacy write after cutover and migrated history equals accepted legacy history; not implemented in code (finding).

eatsbot_core.note: Delivery history replays to the live state when the history row is written atomically; code writes it after_transaction (finding).

eatsbot_extension_kafka.note: Kafka.Driver records :ok only on a matching leader ACK; errors, exits and malformed replies are never recorded as success.

eatsbot_extension_prometheus.note: PromEx tag_values project telemetry onto public tags only, and the scrape is read-only.

eatsbot_extension_telegram_bot.note: verify_secret_token admits only requests whose header equals a valid configured secret, so unverified messages cause no effect.

federation_core.note: Marketplace.decode_verified/2: claimed actor must equal the verified transport actor and all URLs share its origin, so remote input never speaks for local.

federation_service.note: Store.project/5: tombstones are permanent and updates need a strictly higher revision, so reorder/retry cannot resurrect stale or withdrawn listings.

fulfillment_core.note: Only dispatch cancel_confirmed from cancel_requested reaches cancelled; terminal phases refuse events, so a delivery that wins the race is never erased.

group_buy_core.note: BindingRound sets activated once at the first threshold crossing, refuses withdrawal after it, and never moves stock or money.

hawala_capability.note: SignedTestPort.verify_response/3 accepts only TEST-domain frames with zero reserved bytes and the outbox view always reports paid/financial_authority false.

inventory_core.note: Every state reachable by interleaved receive/reserve/commit/release keeps held <= onHand.

keel.note: Every permission Org.can?/4 grants comes from an edge active at t of a valid, acyclic organization (the validity half is intended, not enforced by can?/4).

marketing_core.note: Attribution.eligible?/3: attribution only for confirmed delivery checked in within the window after delivery and after any prior attribution.

order_core.note: Lifecycle.apply answers every unauthorized command with a uniform forbidden before reading version or state, and the reachable states contain no payment or settlement state.

proof_bank_core.note: Every compiled blueprint is unverified, unapproved and inert; candidates carrying self-promotion claims are refused by the closed field set (ProofBankCore.compile/1).

restaurant_core.note: Device-signed restaurant events are admitted only for a key a governance-signed grant bound, with the action among the granted actions.

restaurant_host.note: Against an adversarial host, the administrator signs held bytes only when they decode to the grant shown and replies with the signature alone.

sales_core.note: Consent.record/3: strictly newer events and single-use evidence receipts, so no stale or replayed grant restores consent after withdrawal.

school_ops.note: No planned school task carries a learner-result field or a learner-record reference (TaskCore.Blueprint.normalize/1 closed keys, curriculum-only catalog).

spruce_goose.note: After cutover no legacy ledger import (require_tuxedo/0) or direct CLI write (host marker) succeeds, and the authority cutover cannot be reverted.

task_core.note: Every dispatch of an agent run held an active operator and suggester grant and the task still at the run's expected_task_version (AgentRuns.runnable?/2).
